title: No-offer receive terminal result never requests the exact input handoff
trigger: Deliver valid ZRQINIT in one PTY event, then peer cancellation or a protocol failure in a later event, before the first ZFILE offer. The connection itself stays open.
evidence: session zmodem.rs:585-618 starts a receive lease but emits no UI event
ssh_bridge_zmodem.rs:181-189 captures that lease and sets safety.active
terminal_zmodem.rs:369-400 only requests ResumeInput for a matching current card; no-offer certain terminal outcomes fall through
ssh_bridge_zmodem.rs:152-178 clears active only after exact ResumeInput and flushed writes
impact: Ordinary input remains rejected and tab/window close remains blocked indefinitely; there is no current transfer card from which the user can cancel or recover.
verification: Source-level control-flow proof, not independently recompiled or dynamically reproduced in production.
